dct_title_s: Portugal - Mass Movement in Manteigas, Portugal (EMSR937)
dct_description_sm: This dataset contains Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping products for activation EMSR937. On 18 November 2026, heavy rainfall triggered landslides and debris flows affecting the town of Manteigas, Portugal. The event was ongoing at the time of the activation start and additional heavy rainfall forecast for 21 November 2026 was expected to reactivate unstable slopes, causing further ground movements, debris flows, and impacts to buildings, roads, and critical infrastructure. Copernicus EMS Rapid Mapping was requested to provide landslide extent and damage assessment emergency mapping. **Citation:** Copernicus Emergency Management Service (© 2026 European Union), EMSR937 **Product types present in this dataset's resources:** **GRA (Grading)**: assesses damage to individual features (eg. buildings, infrastructure). Where a GeoPackage download is available for an Area of Interest/round, it already contains every layer with its official Copernicus styling and colours - prefer it in GIS software over the zipped shapefile download.
